target: prominent repeated body markings visible in the photographed body section
definition: 1 means at least three prominent repeated bands, blotches or similar markings are visible in the body region; 0 means no such prominent repeated markings are visible on an adequately visible body section. It does not describe hidden regions or assert absence in the species.
method: Assistant visual inspection of accepted, unblocked local photos. Labels are preliminary, observation-level, and have not been independently verified. Existing source review and renderer-training decisions are unchanged. Seven additional examples were selected after the initial experiment and individually inspected; provider IDs are community assignments, not independent expert verification. Four further examples were selected after the initial experiment and individually inspected; provider IDs are community assignments, not independent expert verification. Ten further patterned examples were selected after the initial experiment and individually inspected; provider IDs are community assignments, not independent expert verification. Eleven further patterned examples were selected after the initial experiment and individually inspected; provider IDs are community assignments, not independent expert verification. Two further examples, including one visibly unpatterned trunk, were selected after the initial experiment and individually inspected; provider IDs are community assignments, not independent expert verification. Four further examples, including two visibly unpatterned trunks, were selected after the initial experiment and individually inspected; provider IDs are community assignments, not independent expert verification. Four further examples, including one visibly unpatterned trunk, were selected after the initial experiment and individually inspected; provider IDs are community assignments, not independent expert verification. Three further visibly unpatterned examples were selected after the initial experiment and individually inspected; provider IDs are community assignments, not independent expert verification.
